Частота обновления — сколько раз в секун: The refresh rate is how many times per second the monitor draws a new image. If it's lower than the monitor supports, extra game frames never reach the screen, no matter how much FPS the graphics card delivers.

С ней монитор подстраивается под FPS игр: With it the monitor adapts to the game's FPS: no tearing or stutter even when there are fewer frames than hertz. NVIDIA calls it G-SYNC, AMD calls it FreeSync, Intel calls it Adaptive Sync.
Включает G-SYNC и FreeSync в играх Direc: Turns on G-SYNC and FreeSync in DirectX 11 games that don't request it themselves. Works only if variable refresh rate is also on in the graphics driver.

Программа проверяет частоту при своём за: The app checks the refresh rate when it starts, when the display mode changes and when a game starts. If it's lower than the monitor supports, you get a notification, at most once a day per display.
После смены частоты программа ждёт подтв: After changing the refresh rate the app waits 15 seconds for confirmation. If the picture is gone and you can't click Keep, the previous rate returns on its own.
